verdict.rationale: Trivy's evidence covers scanning types (vuln, secret, misconfig, license, SBOM), CI/CD exit-code gating, and an MCP server for natural-language querying, but nothing shows a rule engine or webhook/action system that lets a user define custom rules to automatically trigger actions on events (e.g., alerts, notifications, remediation workflows). CI exit-code failing a pipeline is a binary gate, not a configurable rules-to-actions automation layer.
